sources.finding: Henderson had Polynesian settlement centuries ago and is uninhabited in modern times.
2015 beach survey estimated 37.7 million plastic pieces weighing 17.6 tonnes.
By 2015, 9% of generated plastic waste had been recycled, 12% incinerated, 79% accumulated in landfill or environment.
Small plastic fragments can harm aquatic life when ingested; massive species loss is not established here.
The 2050 comparison is a current-track projection, not a guaranteed outcome.
